FAQ

A little clarity before you call.

How do I request towing?

Call 909-827-6022 with your location, destination, and vehicle details to discuss the next steps.

Can I call after hours?

Yes. MCS 86 Towing is available 24/7. Call to confirm service availability at your location.

What information should I provide?

Your exact location, vehicle make and model, condition, service needed, and a way to contact you.

What roadside assistance is available?

Tell us what happened. Call to confirm the specific assistance available for your situation.

How do I check trailer availability?

Share your preferred dates and intended use. Availability, requirements, and terms must be confirmed directly with the team.

How do I get an offer for my junk car?

Share the year, make, model, running condition, location, and title status. Discuss the offer and arrangements with the team.

Do you serve my city?

We serve the Inland Empire and surrounding areas. Call to confirm coverage and availability at your exact location.
